steps.code: assert(IdleWowUIState.__graphicsOriginalEffects,'Use the same owned account/user directory from the preceding graphics routes'); assert(tonumber(GetCVar('particleDensity'))==0.1 and tonumber(GetCVar('environmentDetail'))==0.5)

local original=IdleWowUIState.__graphicsOriginalEffects; for name,value in pairs(original) do SetCVar(name,value) end; for name,value in pairs(original) do local live=GetCVar(name); assert(live==value or (tonumber(live) and tonumber(value) and math.abs(tonumber(live)-tonumber(value))<0.00001),name) end; IdleWowUIState.__graphicsOriginalEffects=nil
